sources.title: Saks Fifth Avenue reviews | Exa place listing
sources.text: Visited Saks 5th Ave to put my nose on a few new scents. Michael & another sales associate were super helpful at the Creed counter. I only travel with my 1 carry on and personal item when I fly, so I couldn’t buy a big bottle; though I was able to get a small flask and they were kind enough to not only fill my atomizer with the scent I really enjoyed but they have me a few samples as well. If you have a budget on splurge on fragrance and want top tier service, don’t hesitate to stop by the Creed counter. You’ll be in good hands. Unika B. & Co. Going during the holidays is really the experience. The interior design of the store is incredible. I particularly love the interior wooden design of the elevators, very classic look. During Christmas, the window displays are a sight to see. Saks puts on one of, if not the, best Christmas light displays on Fifth Avenue, as they use their block-long facade to coordinate lights and music to turn it into a whole show. Truly excellent. Juxtaposed beside the great Rockefeller Center, Saks fifth avenue is absolutely a stop you should take. Very high quality customer service and shops impossible to find in smaller cities. Champagne from Dior was a positive, thank you Louis!

description.value: Saks Fifth Avenue is the flagship department store at 611 Fifth Avenue New York, NY 10022. Its store page lists Store Hours 11:00 AM - 7:00 PM Mon - Sat 12:00 PM - 6:00 PM Sun, and the concierge line is 212-753-4000. For a break, shoppers can stop for drinks and a decadent Parisian-inspired meal at L'Avenue at Saks. The store faces Rockefeller Center and St. Patrick's Cathedral in Midtown. Representative Tripadvisor praise (search snapshot): “It is a real treat to see this flag ship store.”. Representative watch-outs: “Their employees were very snobby in the store.”.
